findings.statement: The repeated comparator failures share an end-to-end semidiscrete-contract defect, not one repeated formula bug: method pieces were selected before reconstruction, deposition, support, covariance, conditioning, and smoothness were proved to define one operator. D-027's target-leg discretization missed conservation/exchange; D-028 restored weak conservation but exposed an ill-conditioned native 1/y^2 reconstruction; D-029 proved a fixed-triple theorem that did not cover its changing selector or exact-node branch.
findings.strongest_counterargument: These are three unrelated candidate methods, and D-028's miss is plausibly only roundoff amplification.
assumptions_used: Frozen caps and stop rules are binding.
A common root may be a repeated specification-to-discretization boundary failure even when proximate numerical mechanisms differ.
W5 is localization evidence, not proof that D-028's underlying weak residual is exclusively roundoff.
counterevidence_refs: D-028 passes every recorded static discriminator except native mu-tau covariance.
W5 reduces the same residual to about 5e-13 in weak/modal metrics.

findings.statement: The current D-035 exact bytes are not implementation-sufficient. The source returns threshold support before validating incoming shells and uses one global shell scale; three binding basis consumers use cached node_values instead of the required coefficient-Horner path; no executable tail integrator exists and Stage B accepts one scalar instead of a directed signed interval; no ArithmeticNode emitter exists and the validator does not bind canonical key grammar, exact operation counts, interfaces, or A4 permutation overlap.
findings.strongest_counterargument: The file is deliberately an unexecuted contract library, so a future caller could supply the missing tail and trace machinery.
assumptions_used: D-035 claims an exact-byte design from which W7's graph must be reconstructible.
A caller assertion cannot replace fail-closed enforcement of a binding shell, basis, tail, or trace obligation.
Directed quadrature values without a continuum remainder do not enclose the continuum tail.
counterevidence_refs: The source correctly freezes 24+15 reactions, exact constants, orientation factors, a 20-row ladder, Horner evaluation itself, and several directed arithmetic primitives.
D-037 independently passes bounded reaction-nullspace, entropy, row-ii, and absolute-normalization subclaims.

findings.statement: Microphysics and finite-mass under-specification genuinely caused D-033/D-034 failure, but it is not the whole current cause. The first W6 used a species-blind four-leg bracket, massless y4 closure for electron reactions, and a non-existent native Radau mass-matrix interface. D-034 then exposed a distinct elastic orientation factor-two, G_F literal drift, and nonconforming shell branches. D-035 corrected the orientation/G_F and bounded continuum algebra: D-037 passes row-ii, absolute normalization, reaction nullspace, and entropy, while failing executable shell enforcement and metrology.
findings.strongest_counterargument: All of these were isolated transcription omissions fixed by successive packets, so no systemic causal lesson remains.
assumptions_used: Pair annihilation does not conserve neutrino pair number, although it conserves lepton number and total energy.
Finite-mass electron reactions require physical four-momentum shells and T_gamma/T_cm ownership, not a massless y sum.
Bounded D-037 passes must not be promoted to whole-design validation.
counterevidence_refs: Current D-035 orientation and exact G_F literals match Tier-0.
D-037's bounded normalization and row-ii passes show that those historical defects were corrected rather than recurrent unchanged.

findings.recommendation: Retain the corrected continuum normalization subclaims and focus any future correction on executable enforcement; do not reopen or refit already closed constants and factors.
findings.forbidden_shortcut: Do not call bounded algebra passes W7 validation or infer complete finite-mass authority from nominal shell vectors.

findings.statement: The recurring detection gap is interface-focused negative coverage. Nominal equilibrium and exact-vector checks passed while resolved non-null adjointness, smallest-node conditioning, support switches, off-shell threshold inputs, per-leg scale rescue, all-consumer basis identity, tail remainder, and trace cardinality remained untested. Later audits did not merely tighten prose standards; they supplied discriminators at previously uncovered interfaces.
findings.strongest_counterargument: The later reviews demanded formal completeness beyond what a practical implementation needs.
assumptions_used: Every listed interface is binding to conservation, covariance, support, or metrology authority.
A nominal positive vector cannot falsify an erroneous failure branch or aggregate rescue rule.
counterevidence_refs: The programme did prospectively freeze S1, native covariance, and exact threshold controls, and those controls stopped unsafe execution.
No physical output escaped the hard stops.

findings.disconfirming_evidence: A preregistered earlier test that exercised each cited interface and passed on the exact failing bytes would weaken this finding; none is recorded.
findings.recommendation: Consolidate a small pre-output negative-control set into existing tests: unequal-scale per-leg shells, off-shell threshold input, forbidden node_values consumer, missing trace count/key, signed tail crossing zero, support switch, and smallest-node covariance.
findings.forbidden_shortcut: Do not add a new standalone readiness gate; place these falsifiers beside the exact source obligations and delete redundant structural checks.

findings.statement: Named-defect patching before whole-contract closure amplified recurrence. The initial tracked W6 was 178 lines; the current candidate is a 621-line proof pack plus a 2,198-line source and 100-line vector file, yet it still has no W7 output and four binding executable gaps. Each correction addressed real new evidence, but source-only counts and nominal equality checks certified the repaired pieces without closing their new interfaces. A larger implementation-and-test push would increase uninterpretable surface before authority, not improve evidence per line.
findings.strongest_counterargument: Incremental exact-byte remediation is rational research: every stop prevented bad output, and later packets substantially improved species, normalization, shell, basis, and metrology detail.
assumptions_used: Line count is a cost signal, not a scientific verdict.
Pre-output failures are cheaper than invalid trajectories, but repeated additive repair can still be inefficient.
The anti-drift policy prefers direct blocker movement and consolidation.
counterevidence_refs: D-035 fixes D-034's orientation/G_F and process-specific shell formulas.

steelman_and_debate.design_evolution_steelman: The sequence was rational in important respects: every candidate addressed a real prior failure class, hard stops prevented invalid trajectories, D-028 passed nearly all static physics gates and W5 supports a conditioning interpretation, D-029 was rejected before implementation, and B3's six-species entropy-variable weak form materially improves the design. Genuine concessions: the first W6 overclaimed theorem and solver closure; D-034's normalization/source failures were real; current D-035 exact bytes are incomplete. Discriminating document test: two blind implementers must independently produce identical typed pseudocode operation graphs and trace/tail schemas from the corrected bytes without choosing an omitted convention.
steelman_and_debate.audit_steelman: Repeated failures reveal specification-to-executable debt, and stopping before expensive output was cost-effective because each missing choice can change physics or a rigorous bound. Genuine concessions: review requirements became more exact over time; not every later obligation was knowable to early candidates; D-028's lone miss is plausibly numerical conditioning rather than wrong continuum physics; D-037 closes several important algebraic subclaims. Discriminating document test: a zero-execution completeness verifier must reject deleted per-leg shell checks, any cached-node basis consumer, a missing signed-tail endpoint, an incomplete trace owner/opcount, or absent A4 permutation overlap.
steelman_and_debate.joint_disposition: Both sides agree that the method family remains plausible, the current bytes are not executable authority, and the next decision must maximize evidence per line without numerical output or blame-based history rewriting.
